While these systems offer powerful data-driven and adaptive capabilities, their complexity, rapid evolution, and dependence on dynamic data pipelines introduce new forms of engineering liability collectively referred to as AI Technical Debts (AITDs). AITDs arise from root causes spanning data governance, model implementation, algorithm design, architectural decisions, operational processes, documentation practices, and testing adequacy. Unlike conventional technical debt, many AITDs are latent and propagate across tightly coupled AI pipelines, leading to maintenance challenges, reliability degradation, and heightened safety or security risks. Guided by the principles of AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), this study reinterprets technical debt through the interconnected dimensions of trustworthiness, focusing on AI safety and security technical debts. We conduct a systematic review of 60 primary studies and identify 31 distinct types of AITD, which are organized into a root-cause-oriented taxonomy comprising seven classes. The analysis examines how these debts map to 18 trust-related concerns, including 6 safety hazards and 12 security vulnerabilities. To support mitigation, the review synthesizes 34 actionable guidelines (8 safety and 26 security) targeting the prevention, detection, and reduction of AITDs across the AI lifecycle. Building on these findings, we introduce AITD-MAP, an integrated framework that connects the AITD taxonomy, quality and risk impacts, and mitigation strategies into a unified structure for risk-aware AI engineering. The framework aims to assist AI software engineers in making AI safety and security technical debts visible, understanding their root causes, and mitigating their presence.

</details>


### [280] [TLA$^{+}$-Bench: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark and Dataset for Natural-Language to TLA+ Specification Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23425)
*Arslan Bisharat,Eric Spencer,Brian Ortiz,Khushboo Bhadauria,Mujtaba Nazari,Beatriz Santos,Anisa Ramos,TaiNing Wang,George K. Thiruvathukal,Konstantin Läufer,Mohammed Abuhamad*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出TLA⁺-Bench，一个通过模型检测器执行来评估LLM生成TLA⁺规范正确性的基准。研究发现，评估正确性会因未明确的选择而产生一个范围（正确性包络），从1.7%到18.7%不等，而最强大的模型在默认设置下正确率仅为16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估方法仅根据与参考规范的相似度或能否通过解析来打分，无法真正衡量生成的TLA⁺规范是否正确。需要一个能够精确判断规范正确性的评估基准。

Method: 构建包含403个经模型检测验证的金标准规范和897个仅通过解析的银标准规范的数据集，利用TLA⁺模型检测器遍历整个可达状态空间，精确判断规范是否正确。同时引入"正确性包络"概念，量化评估选择（如接口命名）对正确率的影响范围。

Result: 相同的模型输出在不同评估选择下正确率从10.0%降到1.7%（6倍差异）；加入接口供给选择后范围扩大到18.7%到1.7%（11倍差异）。最强模型默认正确率16%，给定接口名时为26%，开源模型最高仅1%。模型生成合法TLA⁺的频率远高于正确TLA⁺。

Conclusion: 评估方法的微小选择会导致正确率巨大差异，提出了"正确性包络"来量化这一不确定性。结果表明TLA⁺规范生成任务仍极具挑战性，特别是对于复杂规范。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly write TLA$^{+}$ formal specifications from natural-language descriptions, but progress is hard to measure: existing resources grade by resemblance to a reference or by whether the output parses, neither of which shows correctness. We present TLA$^{+}$-Bench, a dataset and benchmark that grades by execution. Every gold specification ships a configuration the TLA$^{+}$ model checker runs over the full reachable state space, deciding exactly whether the specification holds the properties that configuration names. The dataset holds 403 model-checked gold and 897 parse-only silver specifications from 13 public repositories, subsumes prior TLA$^{+}$ generation data, and carries four model-written descriptions in two styles from two providers, with difficulty and category labels. Our main finding is about measurement itself: an exact oracle gives not one correctness number but a range. Varying only the grading choices earlier benchmarks leave unstated, on one fixed set of model outputs, the correct rate moves sixfold, from 10.0\% to 1.7\%; adding the interface-supply choice, where the model is told the configuration's names, widens the range to elevenfold, from 18.7\% to 1.7\%. We call this range the correctness envelope and measure each of its bounds. The findings inside it are stable. Every model writes valid TLA$^{+}$ far more often than correct TLA$^{+}$: the strongest is correct 16\% of the time by default and 26\% when given the interface names, open models at most 1\%, and correctness falls sharply with difficulty.

</details>


### [281] [LinkRank: A Learning-to-Rank Framework for One-to-Many Issue-Commit Traceability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23610)
*Abhishek Kumar,Tuhin Mondal,Partha Pratim Das,Partha Pratim Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出LinkRank框架，将问题-提交链接恢复视为一对多排序与迭代选择问题，而非独立二元分类，在六个开源项目上显著优于现有方法（Known-K F1 74.54% vs 基线48.39%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多假设问题与提交之间存在一一对应关系，但实际中一个问题常由多个提交共同解决。忽略这种一对多关系会导致追踪不完整，影响软件维护、调试和影响分析等工作。

Method: 提出LinkRank，一种学习排序（learning-to-rank）框架。核心是迭代的“选取-移除-重归一化”策略：每次选出得分最高的提交，从候选池中移除，对剩余得分重归一化，重复直到满足停止条件。支持Known-K（已知链接数量）和Unknown-K（自动停止）两种设置。

Result: 在六个开源项目上，LinkRank在Known-K设置下平均F1达74.54%，远超最强基线48.39%。在Unknown-K设置下，ABS停止规则达68.84% F1，REL停止规则达67.02% F1，均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 一对多的问题-提交追踪更适合作为以问题为中心的排序和迭代选择问题来处理，而不是独立的成对分类问题。

Abstract: Recovering traceability links between issues and commits is important for software maintenance, debugging, impact analysis, and project understanding. However, most existing approaches assume a one-to-one relationship, where each issue is linked to a single commit. In practice, many issues are resolved through multiple commits, and ignoring this one-to-many nature can lead to incomplete traceability. This paper presents LinkRank, a learning-to-rank framework for recovering one-to-many issue--commit links. Unlike existing methods that mainly judge issue--commit pairs independently, LinkRank considers the set of candidate commits for an issue and identifies the commits that are most likely to contribute to its resolution. To support realistic evaluation, we construct a new dataset from six open-source GitHub repositories. LinkRank follows an iterative pick--remove--renormalize strategy: it selects the highest-ranked commit, removes it from the candidate pool, renormalizes the remaining scores, and repeats the process until the stopping criterion is met. We evaluate LinkRank under two settings: Known-K, where the true number of linked commits is available, and Unknown-K, where the model must infer when to stop selecting commits using ABS and REL stopping rules. Across six projects, LinkRank achieves an average Known-K F1 score of 74.54%, compared with 48.39% for the strongest baseline. In the Unknown-K setting, LinkRank achieves 68.84% F1 with ABS and 67.02% F1 with REL, outperforming the strongest baselines under both automatic stopping rules. Overall, the findings suggest that one-to-many issue--commit traceability is better addressed as an issue-centric ranking and iterative selection problem than as independent pairwise classification.

</details>


### [282] [Where Is the Cost of Third-Party API Routers in Agentic Software Development?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23624)
*Donghao Fu,Jingxin Li,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对第三方API路由器在编程智能体工作流中的安全控制缺口进行实证研究，发现路由器可对智能体响应进行四种级别的注入攻击（L1-L4），所有被测试智能体在无额外防御时防御成功率为0%，现有客户端安全机制难以检测此类攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第三方API路由器位于智能体与LLM提供者之间，拥有信任路径，可审查并修改所有请求与响应，但缺乏机制验证提供者输出与最终执行的仓库级行为是否一致，导致客户端权限机制可能失效，且这种控制缺口对软件开发任务的实际影响尚缺乏实证测量。

Method: 提出四种递增隐蔽性的路由器端注入级别：响应替换（L1）、响应追加（L2）、LLM润色注入（L3）、LLM润色+分布对齐注入（L4）；开发SIDEL框架用于轨迹记录、回放、注入与防御评估，构建400样本数据集，测试四种代表性编程智能体，并评估白名单执行控制与LLM审查两种防御机制。

Result: 路由器端干预能显著改变仓库级行为，现有客户端安全机制难以检测；四种智能体在所有注入级别上防御成功率为0%；客户端缓解措施和主动审查能提升抵抗力但无法完全恢复端到端控制。

Conclusion: 揭示了第三方API路由器在编程智能体工作流中存在的严重安全控制缺口，现有防御手段不足，需要提供者端的输出完整性保证机制来弥补这一安全漏洞。

Abstract: Third-party API routers have become a common layer that unifies access across increasingly diverse LLM providers. In coding-agent workflows, high-autonomy operation is widely adopted because it reduces interaction overhead. As a result, a third-party API router, which sits between the agent and the upstream provider, inevitably occupies the trusted path. It can inspect and modify every request and response, yet no mechanism verifies alignment between the provider's output and the repository-level actions ultimately executed by the agent. Consequently, client-side permission mechanisms may become ineffective in practice. Whether this control gap produces real, hard-to-detect effects on software development tasks remains empirically unmeasured. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study of router-side injection in coding agents, examining four intervention levels of increasing subtlety: Response Substitution (L1), Response Append (L2), LLM-Polished Injection (L3), and LLM-Polished with Distribution Alignment Injection (L4). Moreover, we develop SIDEL, a framework for trace recording, replay, injection, and defense evaluation, with a curated dataset of 400 samples. We evaluate four representative coding agents, and further evaluate whitelist-based execution control and LLM review. Router-side intervention substantially alters repository-level actions and remains difficult for existing client-side safeguards to detect. Without additional mitigations, all evaluated agents achieved a defense success rate of 0 percent across all injection levels. Client-side mitigations and reactive reviews improve resistance but do not fully restore end-to-end control, motivating provider-side output-integrity guarantees. Our code is available at https://github.com/Riyasushin/SIDE.

</details>


### [283] [Multi-level Code Optimization via Mixture of Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23665)
*Yun Peng,Jun Wan,Jiakun Liu,Shuzheng Gao,David Lo,Xiaoxue Ren*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Optimo，一种基于LLM和多级提示混合架构的代码优化方法，通过差分剖析识别性能瓶颈并在四个抽象层级进行优化，在基准测试中最高实现57.48%的优化率和3.97倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态语言代码优化面临两大挑战：传统方法依赖编译IR处理静态语言，难以处理无需编译的动态语言；现有LLM方法无法识别合适的优化目标且仅做单层级不全面的优化。

Method: 提出基于MoP（Mixture-of-Prompts）架构的Optimo方法，包含：1) 通过差分剖析识别时间关键型代码结构（性能瓶颈）；2) 将这些瓶颈路由到不同的优化策略（类似MoE中的专家模型）；3) 在四个抽象层级（从粗粒度算法改进到细粒度API优化）执行优化。

Result: 在COFFE和Effibench基准上，Optimo在人工编写代码上最高达57.48%优化率和3.97x加速，最优基线提升96.51%；在LLM生成代码上最高达42.42%优化率和13.51x加速。

Conclusion: Optimo通过多级抽象优化和MoP架构，有效弥补了现有LLM代码优化方法的不足，在动态语言代码优化上显著优于传统方法和现有LLM方法。

Abstract: Runtime efficiency is a critical factor that impacts both software quality and user satisfaction. There are many approaches proposed for code optimization to improve runtime efficiency. Traditional code optimization methods operate on intermediate representations (IRs) during compilation for static languages. They are effective but struggle to handle dynamic languages that do not require compilation. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been leveraged to directly optimize source code in dynamic languages. However, these methods fail to identify suitable optimization targets and usually conduct incomprehensive single-level optimization.
  To address these challenges, we propose Optimo, a multi-level LLM-based code optimization approach built on a novel Mixture-of-Prompts (MoP) architecture. In the MoP architecture, Optimo identifies time-critical code structures as performance bottlenecks via differential profiling. These structures are then routed to some optimization strategies, akin to expert models in MoE, each tailored to optimize specific code patterns. Unlike traditional approaches that focus only on statement-level optimizations, Optimo operates at four levels of abstraction, ranging from coarse-grained algorithmic improvements to fine-grained optimizations in API usage. We evaluate Optimo on two code efficiency benchmarks, COFFE and Effibench. Our results demonstrate that Optimo achieves an up to 57.48% opt%, i.e., the percentage of optimized programs that are correct and at least 10% faster than the original programs, and an up to 3.97x speedup when optimizing human-written code, and it consistently outperforms the best baseline by up to 96.51% in terms of opt%. Furthermore, Optimo achieves an up to 42.42% opt% and an up to 13.51x speedup when optimizing LLM-generated code.

</details>


### [284] [Semantic-Enhanced Automatic Refinement of Architecture Recovery Results Using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23774)
*Yiran Zhang,Chengwei Liu,Yuqiang Sun,Zhengzi Xu,Weisong Sun,Wenke Li,Wuxia Jin,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Semref是一个结合LLM和依赖分析的框架，能自动优化现有架构恢复工具的结果，在9个项目的测试中准确率提升17.72%-118.57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件架构设计与实现之间存在差异，人工提取架构耗时且易错，现有自动恢复工具准确率有限，仍需大量人工修正。

Method: 提出Semref框架，结合大语言模型（LLM）的语义理解能力和结构依赖分析，自动优化现有架构恢复工具的输出结果。

Result: 在9个真实项目上测试10种恢复工具，5个指标均显著提升，归一化增益17.72%-43.35%，MoJoFM和a2a_adj指标相对提升118.57%和100.41%。

Conclusion: Semref能有效减少人工精炼架构恢复结果的工作量，显著提升恢复架构的准确性和可理解性。

Abstract: Understanding the architecture is crucial for effectively maintaining and managing large software systems. However, discrepancies often exist between the designed and implemented architectures, which can pose significant risks. To identify these discrepancies, architects need to extract the architecture from the system implementation, which is both time-consuming and error-prone. To simplify this procedure, many automatic architecture recovery techniques have been developed. Yet, their accuracy is often limited. Architects must still invest significant effort in refining recovery results to ensure they accurately reflect the implemented architecture.
  To reduce such manual effort, we introduce Semref, a framework that combines LLMs with dependency analysis to automatically refine architectures recovered by existing architecture recovery tools. By leveraging the LLM's semantic understanding capabilities and integrating structural dependencies, Semref enhances both the accuracy and the comprehension of recovered architectures. To evaluate Semref, we tested on 9 projects with published ground-truth architectures and 10 state-of-the-art architecture recovery tools. 5 commonly used metrics are adopted to evaluate the effectiveness of Semref. The results show that Semref improves accuracy across various metrics, with normalized gains ranges from 17.72\% to 43.35\%. Specifically, for MoJoFM and $a2a_{adj}$ metrics, Semref achieves relative improvements of 118.57\% and 100.41\%, respectively.

</details>


### [285] [The Influence of Fraudulent AI-Generated Responses on Software Engineering Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23805)
*Ronnie de Souza Santos,Italo Santos,Maria Teresa Baldassarre,Cleyton Magalhaes,Mairieli Wessel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过对四个软件工程调查数据集进行二次分析，发现AI辅助应答对定量结果影响较小，但对定性结果（如上下文框架、代码突出性等）影响较大，强调了多验证程序的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的普及引发了软件工程调查中可能出现欺诈或AI辅助参与的担忧，这可能会影响调查结果的有效性。

Method: 对四个软件工程调查数据集进行二次分析，采用人工识别可疑应答、自动AI生成文本检测、描述性统计分析和主题分析，比较原始数据集与人工清理后数据集的分析结果。

Result: 定量结果在过滤可疑应答后总体稳定，但部分人口统计和分析变量存在中等程度变化；定性结果则受到上下文框架、代码突出性和证据性质变化的显著影响。

Conclusion: AI辅助参与对软件工程调查结果的影响因分析类型而异，强化了在依赖开放式回答的研究中结合多种验证程序的重要性。

Abstract: Background: Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce new concerns regarding fraudulent or AI assisted participation in software engineering surveys. Aims: This study investigates how suspicious or potentially AI assisted responses may affect the validity of software engineering survey findings. Method: We conducted a secondary analysis of four software engineering survey datasets using manual identification of suspicious responses, automated AI generated text detection, descriptive statistical analysis, and thematic analysis. We compared findings obtained from the original and manually cleaned datasets. Results: Quantitative findings generally remained stable after filtering suspicious responses, although some demographic and analytical variables showed moderate variation, affecting the interpretation of specific participant groups and contextual characteristics. In contrast, qualitative findings were more strongly influenced by changes in contextual framing, code prominence, and the nature of the evidence supporting interpretation, shaping how participants' experiences and study contexts were interpreted and characterized. Conclusions: AI assisted participation may influence software engineering survey findings differently depending on the type of analysis being conducted. The findings reinforce the importance of combining multiple validation procedures, particularly in studies relying on open ended responses.

</details>


### [286] [RESTOR: Automated Test Oracle Generation for RESTful APIs via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23963)
*Xun Zhou,Zhen Dong,Mingyu Ren,Qiang Li,JunJie Li,Sifan Wang,Xiaolong Yu,Chaofeng Sha,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Restor框架，利用单次HTTP请求-响应对，通过GRPO微调轻量级LLM自动生成REST API测试断言，在字节跳动工业数据集上F1达85.42%，并将自动生成测试用例的采纳率从74.1%提升至96%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代REST API测试面临测试预言定义困难的问题，尤其在敏捷工业环境中：正式规约（如OpenAPI）经常缺失或过时，历史执行日志对新部署端点不可用，亟需一种能在黑盒设置下从单次观测中自动生成可靠断言的方法。

Method: Restor提出新颖的数据增强流水线，通过GRPO（组相对策略优化）微调轻量级LLM；优化目标联合奖励：（i）选择稳定、语义有意义的字段并避免动态噪声（如时间戳、追踪ID）；（ii）生成能容忍逻辑变化的鲁棒断言。

Result: 在覆盖246个真实服务的2300+API追踪数据集上，F1达85.42%；在字节跳动生产CI/CD流水线中，测试用例自动采纳率从74.1%提升至96%以上。

Conclusion: Restor证明了在缺乏规约和历史日志的工业场景中，利用强化学习微调轻量级LLM能有效生成高质量测试断言，显著减少手动QA工作量，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Modern REST API testing faces a critical challenge in defining reliable test oracles, particularly in agile industrial environments where formal specifications (e.g., OpenAPI) are frequently missing or outdated, and historical execution logs are unavailable for newly deployed endpoints. In this paper, we present Restor (Reinforcement Enhanced Single-Traffic Oracle generator for REST APIs), a framework that generates executable test assertions from a single observed request-response pair in a black-box setting. Unlike existing approaches that rely on rule-based templates or massive training logs, Restor utilizes a novel data augmentation pipeline to fine-tune a lightweight Large Language Model (LLM) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). This training process enables the model to internalize testing "common sense" by optimizing a reward function that jointly encourages: (i) the selection of stable, semantically meaningful fields for validation and the avoidance of dynamic noise (e.g., timestamps or trace IDs); (ii) the generation of robust assertions that withstand logic variations. We evaluate Restor on an industrial dataset comprising over 2,300 API traces across 246 real-world services. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Restor significantly outperforms prompt-engineered baselines and generalist models, achieving a superior $F_1$ score of 85.42% in key field identification and increasing the proportion of semantically accurate assertions. Furthermore, deployment in a production CI/CD workflow at ByteDance confirms its practical value: the system raised the adoption rate of automatically generated test cases from 74.1% to over 96%, substantially reducing manual Quality Assurance (QA) effort while ensuring high execution stability.

</details>


### [287] [Industrial Practice of LLM-Based Test Case Carving and Assertion Generation (Experience Paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24000)
*Haozhen You,Zhen Dong,Jingjing Wang,Qiang Li,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NL2Test是一个端到端工具，能从自然语言描述和流量捕获中自动生成可执行的API回归测试。通过LLM语义理解与确定性算法结合，在51个工业场景中达到82.4%的精确匹配率，并已在生产环境部署9个月，生成了3,196个测试用例，代码采纳率85.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务系统的回归测试常因文档不完整或过时而受限。QA工程师依赖真实流量重建业务场景，但将原始流量转化为可重放的回归测试并生成稳定的验证逻辑，既费力又容易出错。

Method: NL2Test采用端到端方法，输入为自然语言场景描述和流量捕获。包含两个核心任务：(1) 测试用例裁剪——提取最小可重放请求序列，重构数据依赖，使动态值从响应中绑定而非硬编码；(2) 断言生成——生成与业务意图对齐的断言，避免非确定性字段和幻觉路径。使用LLM进行语义解释和受约束代码合成，同时使用确定性算法进行请求过滤、基于值一致性的依赖确认和断言路径验证。

Result: 在51个工业回归场景中，NL2Test精确匹配率达82.4%（42/51），允许少量后编辑时功能可用率98.0%（50/51）。2025年3月起9个月生产部署中，生成3,196个测试用例，代码采纳率85.4%。

Conclusion: 基于流量引导的生成结合确定性护栏，能显著减少手动工作量，提高复杂微服务环境中的回归测试自动化水平。

Abstract: Enterprise regression testing for microservice systems is often constrained by incomplete or outdated documentation. In practice, QA engineers frequently rely on real execution traffic to reconstruct business scenarios; however, turning raw traffic into replayable regression tests with stable validation logic remains labor-intensive and error-prone.
  This paper presents NL2Test, an end-to-end approach and tool that generates executable API regression tests from (i) a natural-language scenario description and (ii) a traffic capture recorded while executing the scenario. NL2Test addresses two coupled tasks: test case carving, which extracts a minimal replayable request sequence and reconstructs data dependencies so that dynamic values are bound from their responses rather than hard-coded; and assertion generation, which produces assertions aligned with business intent while avoiding non-deterministic fields and hallucinated paths. To improve reliability, NL2Test uses LLMs for semantic interpretation and constrained code synthesis, and uses deterministic algorithms for request filtering, dependency confirmation via value consistency, and assertion-path validation.
  We evaluate NL2Test on 51 industrial regression scenarios extracted from a large consumer-facing Internet company. NL2Test achieves an exact-match rate of 82.4% (42/51), and produces a functionally usable draft in 98.0% (50/51) of scenarios when allowing minor post-edits. In a 9-month production deployment starting in March 2025, NL2Test generated 3,196 test cases with an overall code adoption rate of 85.4%. These results indicate that traffic-grounded generation with deterministic guardrails can substantially reduce manual effort while improving regression automation in complex microservice environments.

</details>


### [288] [Four Years of GenAI: How Educators and Industry Adapted Their Assessment Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24246)
*May Mahmoud,Nisa Shahid,Izah Sohail,Gulshan Sharma,Hanan Salam,Sarah Nadi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过调研56名教育工作者和24名招聘专家，发现AI工具在工业界已普遍使用，而教育界仍主要围绕学术诚信制定政策。双方都认可批判性评估AI输出、负责任使用AI工具和学习适应能力等核心技能，但对毕业生在这些技能上的准备程度存在分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究生成式AI时代，入门级软件工程师的核心技能是否发生变化，以及这些技能的评估方式如何演进。

Method: 对56名教育工作者和24名招聘专家进行两项问卷调查，覆盖不同地理区域，对比教育和招聘两个视角。

Result: 1）教育界围绕学术诚信制定AI政策，而工业界已普遍使用AI；2）双方均重视批判性评估AI输出、负责任使用AI和独立学习能力；3）招聘方认为毕业生在基础非AI技能上存在更大差距。

Conclusion: 双方正转向"抗AI评估"（基于实时观察和高阶任务），且对核心技能的重要性认知一致，但对毕业生的实际准备程度存在显著分歧。

Abstract: GenAI's ability to solve a wide range of software engineering tasks is reshaping the software industry, raising the question of what an entry-level software engineer looks like today. In this work, we investigate whether the core skills for entry-level engineers have changed with GenAI and how the assessment of those skills has changed. Through two surveys, we consider both the educational and hiring perspectives, drawing on responses from 56 educators and 24 hiring professionals across diverse geographic regions to identify gaps and misaligned expectations. We find that educators frame their GenAI policies primarily around academic integrity, whereas GenAI use in industry is near-universal, with organizational policy governing how it should be used rather than whether to use it. Policies on GenAI use during interviews are still emerging, and respondents are split on whether they prefer candidates who demonstrate GenAI skills. Both populations are moving toward GenAI-resistant assessments built on observable real-time interactions and higher-order tasks, and both agree on which skills matter most, rating critical evaluation of AI-generated output, responsible and effective use of GenAI tools, and the ability to learn and adapt independently highly. However, they disagree on graduate readiness in these skills: hiring professionals report larger gaps, with the disagreement concentrated on foundational, non-GenAI-specific skills.

</details>


### [289] [Alternative UX Extensions and Their Trade-offs for Code Completion in Pharo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24253)
*Mehdi Elkolei,Omar Abedelkader,Stéphane Ducasse*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Complishon（Pharo 的上下文感知代码补全引擎）的四项扩展：拼写容错、隐式前缀扩展、分组补全条目和驼峰匹配，在保持模块化架构的同时解决了原有严格前缀匹配的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Complishon 已有强大的语义补全能力，但存在严格前缀匹配对打字错误敏感、框架前缀导致冗余输入、补全菜单过大难以浏览、不支持驼峰缩写等实际限制，需要改进用户体验。

Method: 在 Complishon 原有架构（AST分析、懒加载候选生成、基于过滤器的候选选择）基础上，新增四项扩展：1) 拼写容错机制；2) 隐式前缀扩展；3) 分组补全条目；4) 驼峰匹配。每项扩展讨论了实现细节、替代设计方案及相关权衡。

Result: 成功将四项改进集成到 Complishon 中，同时保持了其模块化架构和可预测的行为特性。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于展示了这些改进可以在不破坏系统原有架构的前提下整合进 Complishon，提升了代码补全的实用性和用户体验。

Abstract: Complishon is Pharo's context-aware code completion engine, built on AST analysis, lazy candidate generation, and filter-based candidate selection. Its existing design already provides strong semantic completion, but several practical limits remain. Strict prefix matching is sensitive to small typing errors, framework prefixes often force redundant input, large completion menus are difficult to scan, and prefix-only matching does not support common camel-case abbreviations. This paper presents four extensions that address these limits: typo tolerance, implicit prefix expansion, grouped completion entries, and camel-case matching. For each extension, we describe the implementation, discuss alternative designs, and explain the trade-offs involved. The main contribution of the paper is to show that these improvements can be integrated into Complishon while preserving its modular architecture and predictable behavior.

</details>


### [290] [Motivations and Barriers to Communicating Software Engineering Research: Insights from Early Career Researchers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24387)
*Shalini Chakraborty,Marvin Wyrich,Sven Apel,Sebastian Baltes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过访谈18名软件工程博士生，发现他们在科学传播方面存在强烈的 aspirations 与实践之间的张力，虽受合作、认可、影响力等动机驱动，但社交焦虑、渠道不确定、缺乏指导等障碍阻碍其行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管科学传播对研究职业日益重要，但早期职业软件工程研究人员如何感知和进行科学传播尚不明确，现有研究对此关注不足。

Method: 对18名来自不同国际背景的软件工程博士生进行半结构化访谈，采用主题分析法分析动机、传播渠道和障碍三个维度。

Result: 参与者动机强烈（合作、认可、影响力、自我倡导），但受到社交焦虑、受众/渠道不确定性、反馈机制有限、机构指导不足及传播环境碎片化等障碍制约。

Conclusion: 需要针对不同文化和机构环境，为软件工程博士生提供定制化、平衡的支持系统，以帮助他们有效且有信心地参与科学传播。

Abstract: Science communication is increasingly becoming a part of modern research careers, involving researchers to disseminate knowledge, engage broader communities, and increase the societal impact of their work. Despite its growing importance, little is known about how early-career software engineering researchers perceive and navigate science communication in practice. In this paper, we investigate how PhD students in software engineering experience science communication. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 18 doctoral candidates from diverse international backgrounds. Using thematic analysis, we examine three interconnected dimensions: motivations, communication channels, and barriers. Our findings reveal a strong tension between aspiration and practice. Participants were highly motivated to engage in science communication due to opportunities for collaboration, professional recognition, broader impact, and advocacy for themselves and their research. However, translating these motivations into action was frequently constrained by social anxiety, uncertainty regarding appropriate audiences and communication venues, limited feedback mechanisms, insufficient institutional guidance, and challenges associated with navigating an increasingly fragmented communication landscape. Our findings highlight the need for tailored, balanced support systems that empower software engineering PhD students to engage in science communication effectively and confidently across diverse cultural and institutional environments. We outline practical implications that offer initial guidance for addressing these challenges in future work.

</details>


### [291] [Evaluating the Impact of Explainable AI on Trust in AI-Assisted Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24601)
*Zhenhan Gao,Marvin Muñoz Barón,Umm-e Habiba,Daniel Graziotin,Stefan Wagner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过34人用户实验，研究了不同XAI解释水平对开发者信任AI代码评审的影响。结果显示：完整解释带来最高信任度(3.99/5)，但中等解释带来最高认同率(89.22%)，无解释时信任和认同都最低。说明解释越多，开发者越可能质疑AI建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于自动化代码评审，但其决策背后的推理过程难以理解，开发者难以评估AI生成评审的有效性和可信度，XAI在代码评审中的作用及其对信任的影响尚待探索。

Method: 采用被试内设计，招募34名参与者，比较三种LLM代码评审系统：条件A（详细解释+评审反馈）、条件B（仅评审反馈）、条件C（无解释）。参与者对真实代码变更请求进行评审，测量信任感知、与AI建议的一致性、决策理由及耗时。

Result: 条件A信任度最高(M=3.99/5)，条件B认同率最高(89.22%)，条件C信任和认同均最低。解释水平对评审时间无显著影响。最常引用的决策理由是代码可读性和正确性。

Conclusion: 将XAI纳入代码评审显著改变了信任感知和与AI建议的一致性，为设计可信的AI代码评审系统及AI辅助软件开发中的人因研究提供了参考。

Abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate code review, but the reasoning behind their decisions remains hard to understand. Developers struggle to assess the validity of LLM-generated reviews, making it difficult to gauge how much trust to place in them. The role of Explainable AI (XAI) in code review and its impact on trust remain underexplored.
  Objective: We study the influence of XAI on developer trust in AI-assisted code reviews.
  Method: We conducted a within-subjects user study with 34 participants, comparing three LLM-based code review systems with varying levels of XAI support: Condition A (detailed explanation and review feedback), Condition B (review feedback only), and Condition C (no explanations). Participants reviewed real-world code change requests alongside the AI-generated reviews. We measured trust perceptions, agreement with the AI recommendation, the reasoning given for each decision, and the time taken.
  Results: The level of explanation significantly influences both trust and agreement with AI recommendations, but in different ways. Full explanations (A) yield the highest perceived trust (M = 3.99/5) but not the highest agreement, whereas moderate explanations (B) achieve the highest agreement (89.22%). This could suggest that more explanation prompts developers to question AI recommendations more frequently. No explanations (C) results in the lowest trust and agreement. Explanation level did not significantly affect review time. The most commonly cited reasons for decisions were code readability and correctness.
  Conclusion: Incorporating XAI into code review significantly changes trust perceptions and agreement with AI recommendations. These results inform the design and evaluation of trustworthy AI-based code review systems, as well as studies on the human factors of AI-assisted software development.

</details>


### [292] [Verification-Conditioned Use: A Qualitative Study on How Generative AI Reshapes Learning, Autonomy, and Market Entry for Junior Software Developers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24606)
*Pedro Henrique Andriotte,Danilo Monteiro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过对13名实习生和初级开发者的访谈，发现生成式AI对软件工程新手的影响呈现“验证条件性使用”模式，并揭示了“形成性悖论”：AI诱导的浅层学习反而削弱了市场所需的批判性判断能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从新手自身的视角出发，探究生成式AI工具如何影响软件开发职业生涯的早期阶段，包括使用模式、学习效果、自主性和市场准入四个维度。

Method: 对13名实习生和初级开发者进行一对一视频访谈，采用Braun和Clarke的六阶段主题分析法，以归纳编码和语义分析方式处理数据。

Result: 提炼出16个主题，围绕“验证条件性使用”这一核心概念组织。关键发现：决定是否使用AI的标准不是截止日期或任务复杂度，而是能否验证结果；揭示了“自主性悖论”（感觉更有能力但对结果的所有权更少）和“否认依赖”两个自我感知张力。

Conclusion: 从参与者视角，AI使用的可持续性不在于工具本身，而在于个人实践：在接受前审阅、拒绝无理解的AI使用、要求工具提供解释、以及在AI辅助之外保持刻意练习。

Abstract: Objective: to investigate how the use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools affects the early stages of a career in software development, from the perspective of the newcomers themselves. Method: thirteen interns and junior developers were interviewed individually, by videoconference. Interviews were analyzed using the six phases of Braun and Clarke's thematic analysis, with inductive coding and a semantic approach. Results: sixteen themes emerged, organized around a central concept: verification-conditioned use. Across the study's four research questions (usage patterns, learning, autonomy, and market entry), the criterion that most often decides between AI and manual work is not deadline or task complexity, but the ability to check the result. Two themes expose tensions in newcomers' self-perception: the autonomy paradox (feeling more capable yet less in ownership of the result) and the first-person denial of dependence. Together, these findings point to a theoretical contribution, the formative paradox: the shallow learning that AI induces makes it harder to build the very critical-judgment competence that, according to participants, the market has begun to demand. Conclusion: what makes AI use sustainable, from participants' own point of view, is not the tool itself but the individual practice of reviewing before accepting, refusing to use AI without understanding it, asking the tool for explanations, and keeping deliberate practice outside of AI-assisted work.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [293] [CAPS: Fine-Tuning CCA Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22821)
*Raphael Zailer,Isaac Keslassy*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: CAPS通过分离速率计算和分组调度，利用相位锁定机制将发送端传输与ACK时钟同步，显著减少数据中心拥塞控制中的排队延迟，将最坏情况下的队列占用降低5-10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据中心拥塞控制将速率计算与分组调度耦合在同一反馈环路中，虽能收敛到接近最优的速率，但会留下与流数量成比例的持久队列（standing queues），导致延迟增加。

Method: 提出CAPS（Clocked ACK-Paced Synchronization），一种轻量级分布式调度层。其核心思想是将速率计算与分组调度分离，通过相位锁定使每个发送端的分组在正确的时隙到达瓶颈链路，并针对异构RTT进行逐流校正。

Result: 在哑铃拓扑（等RTT、异构RTT、双向流量）和胖树拓扑（incast、permutation、all-to-all流量）下验证，CAPS在所有测试场景中将最坏情况队列占用降低5-10倍，且不损失吞吐量。

Conclusion: 分离速率计算与分组调度可以简化数据中心拥塞控制设计。给定稳定可行速率后，残余队列问题本质上是时序问题，CAPS通过相位锁定有效解决了该问题。

Abstract: Data-center congestion control targets high throughput, fair bandwidth allocation, and low latency. Modern transports couple rate computation and packet scheduling into a single feedback loop, converging to near-optimal rates but leaving standing queues that can scale with the number of flows. We argue that separating the two reveals a simpler design point. Given stable feasible rates, the residual queue problem reduces to a timing problem: if every flow's packets arrive at the bottleneck in the correct slot, the link stays busy and the queue stays empty. Clocked ACK-Paced Synchronization CAPS is a lightweight distributed scheduling layer that achieves this by phase-locking each sender's transmissions to ACK-clocked bottleneck slots, with a per-flow correction that compensates for heterogeneous RTTs. We characterize the phase-locked steady state for dumbbell topologies under equal RTT, heterogeneous RTT, and bidirectional traffic, and validate the mechanism on a fat-tree under incast, permutation, and all-to-all traffic. CAPS reduces worst-case queue occupancy by 5-10x across all tested scenarios without throughput loss.

</details>


### [294] [Twin-Fidelity-Aware Resolution of Direct xApp Conflicts in Open RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22857)
*Akram Almohammedi,Mohammed Balfaqih,Sam Darshi,Rami Langar,Wael Jaafar*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文针对O-RAN中节能xApp与覆盖/吞吐量xApp的功率控制冲突，提出一种轻量级、无需训练的硬切换仲裁器，通过网络数字孪生保真度监控实现稳健的连续动作选择，在5G仿真中取得接近最优的吞吐量-功耗权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: O-RAN中独立开发的xApps可能产生冲突指令导致网络性能下降，现有基于数字孪生的方法在孪生模型漂移时选择效果不佳。

Method: 提出孪生保真度感知的硬切换仲裁器，利用指数加权移动平均监测预测效用与观测效用的误差，低于阈值时采用孪生选择动作，否则切换到在线学习的历史最优动作。

Result: 归一化效用遗憾0.017±0.006（对比基线0.159±0.052）；严重孪生漂移(10dB)下效用遗憾从11.19±3.58降至0.55±0.25。

Conclusion: 在线孪生保真度监控可有效实现数字孪生辅助的xApp冲突解决，在保持效用感知吞吐量-功耗优化的同时提供鲁棒性。

Abstract: Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) allows independently developed xApps to control RAN functions through the Near-Real-Time RAN Intelligent Controller (Near-RT RIC). When xApps with conflicting objectives operate concurrently, they may issue incompatible actions that degrade network performance. This paper addresses a direct conflict in which an energy-saving (ES) xApp and a coverage/throughput-oriented (CTO) xApp request different downlink transmit-power settings for the same cell. We formulate conflict resolution as online selection of a continuous blend of the two proposals, maximizing an energy-aware utility that jointly considers throughput and power consumption. A network digital twin (NDT) predicts this utility for candidate actions before live deployment, but selecting the highest twin-predicted utility becomes ineffective when the twin drifts. We therefore propose a twin-fidelity-aware hard-switching arbiter that monitors the error between predicted and observed utilities using an exponentially weighted moving average. While the error remains below a threshold, the arbiter follows the NDT-selected action; otherwise, it switches to the best previously observed action learned online. The arbiter is lightweight, training-free, and requires no oracle knowledge of the optimal policy. System-level 5G evaluations show that it achieves the closest throughput-power trade-off to the optimum across operator energy priorities, yielding normalized utility regret of $0.017 \pm 0.006$, versus $0.159 \pm 0.052$ for a COMIX-style twin-based selector. Under severe NDT drift (10 dB), it reduces utility regret from $11.19 \pm 3.58$ to $0.55 \pm 0.25$. These results show that online twin-fidelity monitoring enables robust digital-twin-assisted xApp conflict resolution while preserving utility-aware throughput-power optimization.

</details>


### [295] [Invariant Discovery for Networked Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22944)
*Hongyu Hè,Alexander Krentsel,Sylvia Ratnasamy,Maria Apostolaki*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出Autogram系统，通过将不变量搜索问题分解为AI驱动的语法"发现"和统计驱动的"搜索"两个阶段，利用LLM从网络遥测数据中自动发现可审计、有形式化保证的不变量，在公开和生产数据集上实现了高覆盖率和低误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动编写网络不变量需要同时精通形式逻辑和网络领域的罕见专业知识，现有自动挖掘方法要么需要最难的输入（合法不变量语法），要么只能学到精确的"硬"规则，无法处理真实数据中的噪声。

Method: 将不变量搜索问题分解为两步：(1) AI驱动的语法"发现"阶段，利用LLM进行语义推理来生成合法不变量语法；(2) 统计驱动的"搜索"阶段，在学到的语法内进行搜索，产生可审计且有形式化保证的不变量。

Result: 在公开和生产网络遥测数据上评估，Autogram能够恢复专家推导的不变量，实现了高覆盖率和低误报率。

Conclusion: 通过将LLM的非确定性和幻觉问题约束在语法发现阶段，再由统计方法进行形式化保证的搜索，可以有效地从真实网络数据中自动发现不变量。文章最后讨论了迈向完全开放式发现所面临的开放问题。

Abstract: Invariants, the relations expected to hold among measured signals of a network, underpin applications from verification to traffic generation, telemetry imputation, and input validation, yet writing them by hand demands rare expertise in both formal logic and networking. Automatic miners can help but fall short on two fronts: they still require the hardest input (the grammar of admissible invariants) and they learn only exact, ``hard'' rules, struggling with real-world approximation caused by inherent noise in data. LLMs are tools that can provide semantic reasoning over data, but are non-deterministic and opaque in their learning. Our key idea is to partition the invariant search problem into an AI-driven grammar ``discovery'' problem, followed by a statistics-driven ``search'' problem within the learned grammar. Taken together, this allows non-deterministic, hallucination-prone AI to help produce auditable invariants with formal guarantees. We design and implement such a system, Autogram, and evaluate it on both public and production telemetry data, recovering expert-derived invariants with high coverage and low false positives. We close with discussion on open problems on the path toward fully open-ended discovery.

</details>


### [296] [Building AI That Works: ESnet's Pragmatic Approach to AI-Driven Operational Excellence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22948)
*Bin Dong,Sukhada Gholba,Brooklin Gore,Shawn Kwang,David Mitchell,Samuel Oehlert,Garrett Stewart,Brendan White,Luke Baker,Ed Balas,Britt Gathright,Chin Guok,Jon-Paul Heron,John MacAuley,Scott Richmond,Chris Robb,Chris Tracy,Kesheng Wu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: ORBIT项目开发了一个基于智能体AI的系统（集成于ServiceNow），通过模块化架构、语义搜索和版本化"技能"来简化ESnet NOC工作流，成功交付了8项任务并实现了高采纳率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESnet NOC运营面临三大痛点：数据源检索缓慢、事故工单冗长难解析、轮班交接时上下文丢失，导致认知负荷高、故障解决时间长。同时ESnet 7计划需要更智能的运营支持。

Method: 采用分层模块化架构，包括集中推理中枢、基于MCP的工具接入、语义搜索层和聊天界面。通过版本化、经过测试的"技能"来结构化任务逻辑，提高可靠性和可预测性，系统集成在ServiceNow平台中。

Result: 成功交付全部6个初始任务，并快速开发了NOC工程师提出的2个额外任务。通用基础设施组件（聊天界面和LiteLLM模型网关）获得高采纳率，外部请求量大。实验表明"技能"方法可减少任务完成步骤并消除错误模式。

Conclusion: ORBIT证明了在NOC场景中引入智能体AI的有效性，特别是通过约束性"技能"设计提升了可靠性，同时模块化架构支持了快速扩展和有机采纳。

Abstract: The ORBIT (Operations Responses and Business Intelligence Toolkit) project was initiated to assess agentic AI for the upcoming ESnet 7 initiative and to address persistent operational pain points in the Network Operations Center (NOC) workflow. ESnet operators experience slow retrieval from siloed data sources, incidents described in lengthy and difficult-to-parse tickets, and context loss across shift handoffs. These challenges increase cognitive load and prolong incident resolution times. ORBIT therefore targets routine automation, cross-source synthesis, and actionable insights delivered directly within operators' existing tooling.
  ORBIT is an agentic AI system integrated into ServiceNow, ESnet's primary incident management platform. The design uses a modular, layered architecture comprising a centralized reasoning hub, tool access via MCPs for ESnet data sources, a semantic search layer, and an operator-facing chat interface. To manage the complexity and stochasticity of the AI toolchain, ORBIT follows industry best practices by structuring task logic as versioned, tested "skills" that guide the system in performing bounded responsibilities. This improves reliability and predictability compared to fully unconstrained agent behavior.
  Key results show that ORBIT successfully delivered all six initial tasks, and the architecture enabled rapid development of two additional tasks proposed by NOC engineers. We observed strong organic adoption of general-purpose infrastructure components, especially the chat interface and LiteLLM model gateway, including high request volumes from outside the project. Experiments with skills indicate that this approach can reduce task completion steps while eliminating observed error modes.

</details>


### [297] [ISAC-Enabled On-Demand UAV Charging for Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23572)
*Muhammad Umar Farooq Qaisar,Lin Zhang,Paolo Bellavista,Shehzad Ashraf Chaudhry,Shamsher Ullah,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于集成感知与通信（ISAC）的无人机按需充电框架，通过优先级充电队列和部分充电策略，提升无线可充电传感器网络的能效、缩短充电延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机充电调度缺乏对节点紧急性和移动不确定性的动态感知，导致能效低、延迟高。

Method: 构建优先级充电队列（综合考虑剩余能量、流量负载、飞行时间、航向对齐），利用ISAC实时估计无人机状态动态重排队列，并采用时间分配的部分充电策略。

Result: 在能效、飞行距离和充电延迟方面优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: ISAC赋能的动态调度框架能有效提升WRSN充电性能，并讨论了部署中的计算开销、可扩展性和参数选择问题。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with wireless power transfer (WPT) extend the lifetime of wireless rechargeable sensor networks (WRSNs) by delivering energy on demand. This article presents an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)-enabled on-demand UAV charging framework coordinated by a central base station. A prioritized charging queue captures node urgency and service cost through residual energy, traffic load, estimated UAV travel time, and flight-direction alignment. This bidirectional coupling ensures that scheduling decisions shape the UAV trajectory, while updated mobility estimates from ISAC dynamically reorder the queue. ISAC-assisted estimation of UAV distance, speed, and position updates travel-time predictions under mobility uncertainty. A time-allocated partial charging policy distributes limited hover time across queued nodes according to criticality. Simulations show gains in energy usage efficiency, travel distance, and charging delay compared with representative baselines. We discuss deployment considerations, including computational overhead, scalability, and parameter selection, to aid practitioners evaluating the framework for IoT scenarios.

</details>


### [298] [TRUAV: Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Trajectory Planning and Routing Enhancement in UAV-Aided IoT-Enabled VANETs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23734)
*Muhammad Umar Farooq Qaisar,Lin Zhang,Zhen Chen,Wajdy Othman,Shehzad Ashraf Chaudhry,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于分布式多智能体Q学习的无人机轨迹规划与路由增强框架TRUAV，在无需全局信息交换的情况下，实现了与集中式深度强化学习相当的覆盖率和投递率，同时提升了时延和能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统集中式无人机轨迹规划需要持续聚合全局网络状态，在带宽和能量受限的密集城市部署中不切实际，因此需要一种分布式、低开销的解决方案。

Method: 采用独立表格Q学习的分布式多智能体强化学习框架，每个无人机基于局部可观测信息（车辆密度、队列状态、邻居位置）进行决策，并结合势博弈启发式奖励设计鼓励空间多样性与路由感知。

Result: 在包含200辆移动车辆的大规模城区仿真中，TRUAV在网络覆盖和分组投递率上与集中式深度强化学习方法相当，同时改善了中继时延和能效。

Conclusion: 分布式多智能体Q学习框架能有效解决无人机辅助物联网中的轨迹规划与路由问题，为未来分布式无人机系统提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a key enabler of next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystems, offering flexible aerial relaying to extend connectivity across dynamic vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) in smart city environments. However, conventional centralized approaches for UAV trajectory planning require continuous global network state aggregation, making them impractical under bandwidth and energy constraints typical of dense urban deployments. In this article, we present TRUAV, a distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on independent tabular Q-learning for joint UAV trajectory planning and routing enhancement in UAV-aided VANETs. Each UAV is equipped with a local Q-learning agent that operates purely on locally observable information, including vehicle density, packet queue states, and neighbor UAV positions, thereby eliminating the need for global state exchange. A potential-game-inspired reward design encourages spatial diversity and routing-aware UAV positioning among interacting agents while accounting for energy consumption. Numerical simulations over a large urban area with 200 mobile vehicles show that the proposed TRUAV framework achieves network coverage and packet delivery ratios comparable to centralized deep reinforcement learning methods, while also improving relay delay and energy efficiency. Finally, we discuss emerging challenges and future research directions for distributed multi-agent UAV-assisted IoT systems.

</details>


### [299] [Fake It No More: Evaluating L4S with SCReAM on Video Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23767)
*Nawel Alioua,Ryan Zanone,Cheng Xi,Elizabeth Belding*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文通过开源DualPI2实现和Mahimahi模拟器，评估了L4S对SCReAM拥塞控制视频传输的影响。结果显示L4S可降低35%的尾延迟，但吞吐量下降42%，且在丢包场景下能带来更明显的QoE收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低延迟、低丢包、可扩展吞吐量（L4S）对交互式多媒体应用日益重要，但现有研究较少评估L4S对实际视频传输QoE的影响，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于开源DualPI2实现，在Mahimahi模拟器上增强SCReAM带宽工具（加入视频编解码器），生成真实视频流量。在移动网络轨迹、随机丢包和不同运动复杂度条件下，评估网络级和QoE指标。

Result: L4S在基线场景中使中位数第95百分位队列延迟降低35%，但发送端吞吐量下降42%。在1%丢包下，L4S的QoE增益比无损场景更显著。不同视频内容复杂度下，L4S的QoE稳定性优于Classic。

Conclusion: 评估L4S对终端应用性能的影响时，必须同时考虑QoE和网络级指标，仅看网络指标可能无法全面反映L4S的实际效果。

Abstract: The growing interest in Low Latency, Low Loss, and Scalable Throughput (L4S) reflects the need for lower latency in interactive multimedia applications. In this paper, we use an open-source DualPI2 implementation over the Mahimahi emulator to evaluate the impact of L4S on SCReAM congestion controlled video traffic. To do so, we augment the SCReAM BW tool with a video codec, enabling the generation of video traffic in addition to its original synthetic RTP mode. We evaluate both network-level and Quality of Experience (QoE) metrics on a mobile network trace, under random packet loss, and with different motion-complexity levels. In our baseline scenario, L4S reduces the median per-run $95^{th}$ percentile queue delay by 35%, at the cost of a 42% drop in sender throughput. Under 1% packet loss, L4S yields more pronounced QoE gains compared to the lossless scenario, despite narrower network-level benefits. Across video content complexities, L4S also maintains more stable QoE than Classic. These results underscore the importance of evaluating QoE alongside network-level metrics when assessing the effect of L4S on end-user application performance.

</details>


### [300] [GNN-based Multi-Agent Control of Traffic Shockwaves in Sparse Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23792)
*Prachi Nandi,Madhuri Malakar,Sonakshi Satpathy,Pabitra Mohan Khilar*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的 decentralized 多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，让联网自动驾驶车辆仅利用局部信息就能学习协作控制策略，在仅10%车辆连接时仍能将交通冲击波传播减少高达80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通冲击波是造成拥堵、燃油效率低和事故率升高的主因之一；现有CAV控制策略大多依赖全局交通信息，在VANET早期部署阶段不切实际。

Method: 提出将GNN集成到decentralized MARL框架中，使车辆能通过与邻近车辆交互来学习合作控制策略，仅依赖局部可用信息。

Result: 在可扩展仿真环境中，即使在仅10%车辆为联网车辆的条件下，该框架也能将交通冲击波传播减少高达80%。

Conclusion: 所提出的GNN-based MARL框架能有效缓解交通冲击波，且适用于联网车辆渗透率较低的现实场景，具有实际部署价值。

Abstract: Traffic shockwaves are stop-and-go waves that propagate upstream through the streams of vehicles and are one of the major causes of traffic congestion, fuel inefficiency, and increased accident rates in modern transportation systems. Although Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) offer a promising opportunity to mitigate such shockwaves, most existing control strategies rely on global traffic state information, making them impractical for early-stage deployment of Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs). In this paper, we propose a decentralized Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework that integrates a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to enhance the control architecture of connected and autonomous vehicles. The proposed approach enables vehicles to learn cooperative control policies using locally available information and interaction with neighboring vehicles. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is evaluated using a scalable simulation environment under realistic highway traffic conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed GNN-based MARL framework can reduce the propagation of traffic shockwaves by up to 80\%, even when only 10\% of the vehicles are connected.

</details>


### [301] [HAPS-enabled Downlink Coverage Enhancement in Islands and Maritime Areas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23848)
*Hao Lin,Mustafa A. Kishk,Mohamed-Slim Alouini*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究了利用高空平台站（HAPS）大规模部署为岛屿和海洋用户提供连接服务的可行性，特别考虑了岛屿建筑群对HAPS造成的实际阴影效应，分析了近海和远海用户的覆盖性能，并提出了混合信道环境下的评估方法与近似方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统地面网络在偏远岛屿和海洋区域部署成本高、难度大，而NTN中的HAPS有望克服这些限制。本文旨在探索HAPS大规模部署为这些难以覆盖区域提供连接的可行性。

Method: 1) 对陆上（岛屿）用户采用阴影Rician分布信道建模，对海上用户采用Rician分布信道建模；2) 针对近海用户在混合信道环境下提出评估方法；3) 提出降低计算复杂度的近似方法；4) 通过仿真分析岛屿边界距离和HAPS密度对覆盖性能的影响。

Result: 揭示了岛屿边界距离（即海上用户的相对远近程度）在不同HAPS密度下对覆盖性能的影响规律，强调了选择平衡的HAPS密度或采用先进的HAPS部署方案的重要性。

Conclusion: HAPS大规模部署有望为岛屿和海洋用户提供可行的连接方案，但需注意实际阴影效应的影响，合理选择HAPS密度或采用更先进的部署策略是提升覆盖性能的关键。

Abstract: Non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) are poised to play a critical role in next-generation mobile communications, offering enhanced flexibility, improved line-of-sight (LoS) conditions, and overcoming the limitations of terrestrial networks (TNs). Among NTN platforms, high altitude platform stations (HAPSs) have emerged as a promising solution to provide Internet connectivity to underserved regions, including rural areas, islands, and maritime zones, where traditional infrastructure deployment is costly and challenging to deploy. In this paper, we investigate the feasibility of large-scale HAPS deployment to connect island and maritime users, considering real-world shadowing effects on part of HAPSs caused by the presence of island building clusters. We first analyze the coverage performance of onshore (island) and offshore (remote sea) users, in which the channels between HAPSs and the user follow the shadowed Rician distributions and Rician distributions, respectively. Next, we introduce an evaluation method for nearshore users in a hybrid channel environment with HAPSs, and propose approximations that can reduce computational complexity. Based on the simulation results, we discuss how the distance from the island boundary (i.e. the relative remoteness of maritime users) affects coverage performance under different HAPS densities. We also emphasize the importance of choosing a balanced HAPS density or an advanced HAPS deployment scheme.

</details>


### [302] [6G: From Connectivity Infrastructure to Guaranteed Digital Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24185)
*David Soldani,Petrit Nahi,Awn Muhammad,Nikhil Dwivedi,Francesco Monaco,Francis Jebamani*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出6G应颠覆前五代由供应商主导的架构，转向运营商可控的五大优先原则，并通过Control Compact、Guarantee Economy、Network MCP平台及标准化提案四部分构建可落地的架构框架与商用路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前五代移动网络由供应商主导，导致运营商无法完全修改平台、无法审计AI推理层，架构主权丧失。作者认为6G应逆转这一趋势，重新确立运营商的控制权与可审计性。

Method: 提出五项优先级重排（控制优先、客户结果优先、商业保障优先、软件驱动+可治理AI、技术服务于上述目标），并配套四项贡献：Control Compact（所有权-联邦-消费的分类法）、Guarantee Economy（六级按结果定价模型）、Network MCP平台（自治代理通过可审计工具面接入SBA）、以及标准化立场与三阶段路线图。

Result: 形成了从架构主权分配、商业模型转化、AI治理机制到标准化提案的完整框架，并基于运营商级云原生Open RAN与核心网的实际部署经验提供了操作证据。

Conclusion: 6G的转折点不仅是技术升级，更是架构治理范式的根本重构。只有运营商掌握架构主权、AI可审计、商业结果可保障，6G才能摆脱前五代的路径依赖。

Abstract: Sixth-generation mobile networks are approaching a structural inflection point. Five generations of vendor-led architecture have left operators dependent on platforms they cannot fully modify and artificial-intelligence inference layers they cannot audit. This article argues that 6G should reverse that trajectory by reordering five priorities: control first; customer outcomes before peak rates; business guarantees before megabytes; software-driven operations with governed agentic artificial intelligence; and technology in service of those priorities. Four contributions operationalize the thesis. The Control Compact is an own-federate-consume taxonomy that allocates architectural sovereignty by strategic value. The Guarantee Economy is a six-tier outcome-priced model aligned with IMT-2030 usage scenarios and converts operator control into enforceable service-level objectives. An operator-grade Network MCP Platform shows how autonomous agents could enter the service-based architecture through a governed tool plane with auditable hooks for identity, charging, lawful intercept, enforcement, and digital-twin validation. A standardization section states Rakuten Mobile's public position on AI-agent scope, radio access, migration, non-terrestrial networks, physical layer, core, and spectrum. The framework distinguishes operational evidence from national-scale cloud-native Open RAN and core network deployments, standards-grounded extrapolation, and forward-looking architecture and commercial proposals. A three-phase roadmap separates standards milestones from operator deployment targets and identifies validation gates and stakeholder implications.

</details>


### [303] [DeepNC: A Fast GNN-based Pre-Verification Surrogate for TSN Configuration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24398)
*Jiayi Zhu,Jing Lin,Zelong Tian,Feng He,Luxi Zhao*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出DeepNC，一种将网络演算(Network Calculus)原理融合到图神经网络(GNN)中的预验证代理模块，作为高速过滤机制，显著加速TSN配置空间探索中的调度验证过程，减少93.25%的形式验证调用，并将验证速度提升两个以上数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在TSN配置空间自动探索中，重复的可调度性分析消耗了超过90%的总配置时间，成为大规模TSN配置的主要瓶颈。需要一种方法来加速这一过程，同时不牺牲形式验证的可靠性。

Method: 提出DeepNC，首次将网络演算(NC)原理结构化地融合进图神经网络(GNN)中，作为预验证代理模块。DeepNC不替代形式验证，而是作为高速预验证过滤器，仅对最有希望的候选配置进行昂贵的正式验证。

Result: 相比最先进的基于学习方法，DeepNC最坏情况延迟预测的R²平均提升55.8%，MAPE平均降低65.3%；在配置空间探索中减少93.25%的形式验证调用，加速NC验证两个以上数量级。

Conclusion: DeepNC成功地将NC原理与GNN相结合，在保持高保真度回归能力的同时，大幅降低了TSN配置空间探索的计算开销，为大规模确定性网络自动化配置提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) is critical to deterministic communication in safety-critical domains, with formal verification such as Network Calculus (NC) serving as the cornerstone for schedulability guarantees. However, during automated configuration-space exploration, repeated schedulability analysis consumes over 90% of the total configuration time, becoming the primary bottleneck for large-scale TSN configurations. To address this challenge, we propose DeepNC, a novel pre-verification surrogate module that pioneers the structural fusion of NC principles into a Graph Neural Network (GNN) for TSN configuration-space exploration. Rather than replacing formal verification, DeepNC acts as a high-speed pre-verification filter, reserving computationally expensive formal verification only for promising candidates. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DeepNC significantly improves worst-case delay prediction accuracy over state-of-the-art learning-based methods, increasing the average $R^2$ by 55.8% and reducing the average MAPE by 65.3%. More importantly, its high-fidelity regression substantially reduces the number of formal verification calls during configuration-space exploration by 93.25%, while accelerating NC-based verification by more than two orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [304] [Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24692)
*Jhonatan Tavori,Gur-Eyal Sela,Ion Stoica,Gil Zussman*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一种新型攻击面——**负载整形攻击**（如Yo-Yo突发流量），可通过引发慢路径共享资源争用，使良性用户的慢路径预测超过延迟截止时间而被丢弃，导致**精度崩溃**（accuracy collapse）。在自动驾驶多目标跟踪的两层边缘-云推理管线中，约4000个突发请求即可使p99延迟从92ms暴涨至2s，跟踪质量平均下降7.0 HOTA点，某些稀有类别损失近半预测精度。攻击无需模型权重或受害者数据即可实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理系统普遍采用“快路径+高精度慢路径”的混合架构，其中协调层（路由+合并）的关键假设是慢路径结果总能按时返回。但这一协调层暴露了新的攻击面——攻击者可通过构造工作负载（如突发请求）在慢路径的共享资源上制造争用，导致良性用户的慢路径结果超时被丢弃，进而失去精度增益。作者旨在揭示并量化这一新型安全威胁。

Method: 作者将推理管线的协调层抽象为**路由**（决定何时调用慢路径）和**合并**（决定是否采纳慢路径结果）两部分。攻击方法为**负载整形攻击**（Yo-Yo突发模式），通过在慢路径的共享资源（如云端GPU）制造争用，使良性请求的慢路径延迟超过截止时间，导致合并器丢弃其预测结果，系统退化为仅依赖快路径的低精度状态。

Result: 在自动驾驶多目标跟踪场景中，约4000个突发请求将良性用户的p99延迟从92ms推高至2s，几乎消除慢路径的精度增益，平均降低7.0 HOTA点。攻击效果因攻击目标视频区间而异（2.0–18.7 HOTA点），稀有类别（如停车标志）预测精度损失近半。攻击无需模型权重或受害者数据。

Conclusion: 负载整形攻击可有效导致精度崩溃，这对混合推理管线的可靠性构成严重威胁。作者呼吁对路由、合并、调度及资源隔离等方面的攻击与防御展开进一步研究。

Abstract: Inference systems increasingly combine a fast path that returns predictions within the application's latency deadline together with a higher-accuracy slow path that runs higher-compute methods on stronger, remote hardware, so its results can be returned on time and combined with the fast path predictions. Across several application domains, we abstract this inference architecture as a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer with two functions: a router that invokes the slow path and a merger that decides whether to incorporate its returned predictions. In this work, we show that this new coordination layer exposes a new attack surface: shaped workload attacks, e.g., Yo-Yo bursts, can exploit contention at shared resources along the slow path to push benign users' slow-path predictions past their latency deadlines. The merger then discards those predictions, while the fast path continues to return timely outputs. We refer to the resulting loss of slow-path accuracy benefits as accuracy collapse.
  We demonstrate accuracy collapse in a two-tier edge-cloud multi-object tracking pipeline in autonomous driving. In simulation, approximately 4,000 burst-shaped requests increase benign p99 latency from 92ms to 2s, nearly eliminating the benefit of the slow path's cloud inference, reducing object tracking quality by 7.0 HOTA points on average. We further find that accuracy degradation can significantly vary (2.0-18.7 HOTA points), depending on the video intervals that are targeted in the attack, and that certain rare classes (e.g., stop signs) lose nearly half of their pre-attack prediction accuracy. These results show that workload attacks can degrade prediction quality without needing either access to model weights or victim data, and motivate research on attacks and defenses for routing, merging, scheduling, and resource isolation in these emerging inference pipeline architectures.

</details>

### [305] [Scoping Review of AI, Metrology, and ESG in the Semiconductor Sector: Implications for Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23082)
*Karen Ang,Han-Teng Liao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文通过范围综述（1,465篇文献）揭示了半导体制造业AI应用与可持续性监管之间的结构性断裂，并提出了一种基于系统之系统（SoS）范式的6层SSbD架构，通过虚拟计量、联邦学习和RegTech机制构建可溯源的数据结构，将法规遵从转化为创新驱动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体行业面临双重转型压力：一方面需通过AI提升制造效率，另一方面必须满足欧盟CBAM等严格的可持续性监管要求。现有研究在AI驱动工艺优化与下游可持续治理之间存在明显的知识断裂（structural hole），亟需弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 采用范围综述方法，从Web of Science和Scopus中筛选1,465篇文献，运用网络分析识别知识结构；进而提出6层SSbD架构，涵盖grid-to-core和standards-through-supply-chain两条集成路径，整合虚拟计量、联邦学习与防御性RegTech机制。

Result: 网络分析揭示出高度碎片化的"核心-边缘"知识结构，明确识别出AI工艺优化与可持续治理之间的结构性裂口。提出的SSbD架构展示了如何通过可溯源数据结构实现安全、气候中和及循环价值链。

Conclusion: 该架构将法规遵从重新定位为创新驱动力，为半导体制造行业在安全、可持续和循环价值方面提供了可行的技术实现路径。

Abstract: The semiconductor sector faces a dual transition: scaling manufacturing execution through Artificial Intelligence (AI) while satisfying stringent sustainability mandates, such as the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). This paper presents a scoping review of 1,465 documents indexed in Web of Science and Scopus, spanning AI-integrated metrology, supply chain ESG, and federated industrial data spaces. Network analysis reveals a highly fragmented "core-periphery" knowledge structure, emphasizing a critical structural hole between AI-driven process optimization and downstream sustainability governance. To close these gaps, this study proposes a 6-layer Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) architecture grounded in a System of Systems (SoS) paradigm. By establishing distinct "grid-to-core" and "standards-through-supply-chain" integration pathways, the proposed framework demonstrates how virtual metrology (VM), localized federated learning, and defensive RegTech mechanisms can build provenance-aware data fabrics. Ultimately, this architecture positions regulatory compliance as a driver for innovation, enabling secure, climate-neutral, and circular value chains in semiconductor manufacturing.

</details>


### [306] [A Novel Gravity-Quasi-Laplacian Approach to Identifying Influential Nodes in Complex Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23419)
*Shima Esfandiari,Seyed Mostafa Fakhrahmad*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无参数、高效的重力-拟拉普拉斯节点影响力排名框架，仅使用度和k-shell指标，在9个真实网络上优于8种现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有节点影响力排名方法存在精度不足、分辨率低、依赖可调参数、计算复杂度高等局限性，难以适用于大规模真实网络。

Method: 结合拟拉普拉斯结构度量与重力启发式聚合，利用节点的度和k-shell指标构建结构角色强化表示，通过短程交互机制（固定重力半径R=3）评估局部影响力。

Result: 在9个真实网络上与8种最新方法的对比实验表明，该方法在精度、分辨率和计算简洁性上均持续优于现有技术。

Conclusion: 重力-拟拉普拉斯范式是一种可靠且可扩展的工具，适用于识别复杂网络中的关键节点。

Abstract: Identifying influential nodes in complex networks is a fundamental challenge with broad applications in areas such as social network analysis, communication infrastructure, transportation systems, and information networks. Existing ranking methods typically rely on combinations of structural features-such as degree, k-shell index, and neighborhood connectivity-to estimate a node's importance. However, many of these approaches suffer from key limitations, including insufficient accuracy, low resolution in distinguishing nodes with similar influence, dependence on tunable parameters, and high computational complexity, which restrict their practicality in large-scale or real-world networks. This study introduces a new ranking framework that integrates a quasi-Laplacian structural measure with a gravity-inspired aggregation process. The core idea is to construct a strengthened representation of each node's structural role using only simple yet informative attributes-namely degree and k-shell index-and then evaluate its local influence through a short-range interaction mechanism. The proposed approach is designed to be free of tunable parameters, interpretable, and computationally efficient, requiring only a small fixed gravity radius (R=3), which makes it suitable for large and diverse networks. Experiments conducted on nine real-world networks and compared against eight state-of-the-art methods demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing techniques in terms of accuracy, resolution, and computational simplicity. These results highlight the effectiveness of the gravity-quasi-Laplacian paradigm as a reliable and scalable tool for identifying influential nodes in complex networks.

</details>


### [307] [GTIN: A Unified Framework for Joint Event and Time Prediction in Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23556)
*Mohammad Ostadmohammadi,Sepehr Kazemi,Hamid R. Rabiee*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一数学框架，用于在时序图中联合预测下一个事件及其发生时间，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序图广泛应用于社交、金融、交通等动态系统，但预测下一个事件是什么以及何时发生这一关键问题尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 提出了一个统一的数学框架，能够捕捉时序图中不同程度的复杂度，并在此基础上设计了联合预测下一个事件及其发生时间的新方法。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在处理不规则事件模式和复杂时间依赖关系时，一致优于现有技术。

Conclusion: 该框架可作为时序事件预测未来研究的稳健基础。

Abstract: Temporal graphs are increasingly used to model dynamic systems in diverse domains such as social networks, financial networks, and traffic networks. Predicting both what the next event will be and when it will occur in these systems is crucial for understanding and anticipating complex behaviors, but has not been studied much. To address this gap, we propose a unified mathematical framework capable of capturing varying degrees of complexity across temporal graphs. Our framework is flexible and expressive enough to accommodate a wide range of network structures and temporal dynamics. Building upon this analysis, we introduce our novel approach for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time. Empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing techniques, particularly in scenarios involving irregular event patterns and complex temporal dependencies. These findings highlight the potential of our framework as a robust foundation for future research in temporal event prediction.

</details>


### [308] [Separating Clicks from Baits: Using Large Language Models to Detect Misleading YouTube Thumbnails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23739)
*Wajiha Naveed,Muhammad Muneeb Pervez,Zaeem Mohtashim Khan,Zafar Ayyub Qazi,Zartash Afzal Uzmi*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用LLM的多模态检测流程，用于识别YouTube等平台上的误导性视频缩略图。研究者构建了包含2,843个视频（含1,359个误导性缩略图）的多国数据集，评估了多个前沿LLM的性能。Claude 3.5 Sonnet表现最佳，准确率达93.8%，精确率超92%，召回率超94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: YouTube等平台上的误导性视频缩略图普遍存在，严重损害用户信任和平台诚信。现有检测方法缺乏跨文化视角且未能充分利用多模态信息，亟需一种更全面、可扩展的自动化检测方案。

Method: 构建包含8个国家2,843个视频的多模态数据集（含7.6亿+观看量的误导性样本）；提出融合视频描述、缩略图图像和字幕文本的检测流程；评估GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet等4个前沿LLM及2个开源视觉语言模型；进行系统性提示工程和失败分析。

Result: Claude 3.5 Sonnet表现最优：准确率93.8%，精确率>92%，召回率>94%。整体结果表明LLM在识别误导性缩略图方面有效，但存在特定场景下的失败模式。

Conclusion: LLM多模态检测方法能有效提升内容审核能力，为构建更透明、可信的视频平台奠定基础，但部署时需考虑伦理影响和系统局限性。

Abstract: Misleading video thumbnails on platforms like YouTube are a pervasive problem, undermining user trust and platform integrity. This paper proposes a novel multi-modal detection pipeline that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to flag misleading thumbnails. We first construct a comprehensive dataset of 2,843 videos from eight countries, including 1,359 misleading thumbnail videos that collectively amassed over 7.6 billion views, providing a unique cross-cultural perspective on this global issue. Our detection pipeline integrates video-to-text descriptions, thumbnail images, and subtitle transcripts to holistically analyze content and flag misleading thumbnails. Through extensive experimentation and prompt engineering, we evaluate the performance of four frontier-level LLMs, including GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini-1.5 Flash. We further evaluate open-weight vision-language models, LLaVA-v1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, to assess the generalizability of our approach beyond proprietary systems. Our findings show the effectiveness of LLMs in identifying misleading thumbnails, with Claude 3.5 Sonnet consistently showing strong performance, achieving an accuracy of 93.8%, precision over 92%, and recall exceeding 94% in certain scenarios. Beyond evaluating detection performance, we conducted a careful failure analysis to understand when LLMs fail in identifying misleading thumbnails. We discuss the implications of our findings for content moderation, user experience, and the ethical considerations of deploying such systems at scale. Our findings pave the way for more transparent, trustworthy video platforms and stronger content integrity for audiences worldwide.

</details>


### [309] [Mapping the Reddit Bot Ecosystem: Taxonomy and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23941)
*Qiusi Sun,Thomas Gaskin,Branko Blagojevic,Milena Tsvetkova*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 基于Reddit平台3,389个机器人数据，通过聚类分析识别出18种机器人类型，发现机器人数量在COVID-19期间达到顶峰后开始下降，但物种多样性保持稳定，形成演化的数字生态系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化代理越来越多地参与在线社区，但其种群结构和角色仍未被充分理解，因此需要系统性地分类和分析机器人类型及其演化规律。

Method: 收集3,389个已识别机器人的完整活动历史，基于时间、社区、语言和语义特征构建机器人分类体系，并运用聚类分析方法。

Result: 识别出18种不同的机器人类型，涵盖内容专业化、行为驱动型和基础设施型（如审核和实用支持）角色；机器人数量和活动在COVID-19时期达到顶峰后开始下降；机器人物种多样性保持稳定。

Conclusion: 在线机器人种群形成不断演化的数字生态系统。

Abstract: Automated agents increasingly participate in online communities, yet their population structure and roles remain poorly understood. Using a dataset of 3,389 identified bots and their full activity histories, we construct a taxonomy of bot "species" on the news aggregation and social media platform Reddit based on temporal, community, linguistic, and semantic features. Clustering analysis reveals 18 distinct bot types spanning content-specialized, behavior-driven, and infrastructural roles such as moderation and utility support. In addition, temporal analysis shows that bot numbers and activity expanded rapidly before peaking around the COVID-19 period, then started declining even before Reddit's 2023 API policy changes. However, the overall diversity of bot species has remained remarkably stable. These findings suggest that online bot populations form evolving digital ecosystems.

</details>


### [310] [Modeling Duelling Contagions of True and False Information in the Face of Inherent Individual biases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24360)
*Vaibhav Krishna,Hirokazu Shirado,Feng Fu,Nicholas A. Christakis*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于“复杂传染”和“沉默螺旋”理论的智能体共扩散模型，研究真假信息在网络中的竞争扩散机制。发现操纵性叙事在早期传播者占据优势时易主导网络，而早期引入低自我审查智能体可有效抑制操纵、促进理性信息主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中真假信息往往同时传播，现有研究未能充分建模这种竞争性共扩散过程及其对认知偏差的利用机制。

Method: 提出基于智能体的共扩散模型（co-diffusion model），融合复杂传染理论（复杂 contagion）和沉默螺旋理论（spiral of silence），模拟网络动力学如何利用认知偏差影响信息扩散。

Result: 1) 操纵性叙事在早期传播者占优势时最易主导；2) 网络动力学能够放大信息扩散，不论信息真实性；3) 有利经验增强集体乐观，不利经验仅适度削弱乐观；4) 早期引入低自我审查智能体可抑制操纵并促进理性信息主导。

Conclusion: 研究为促进健康公共话语、增强社会凝聚力、保障可靠信息公平获取提供了政策启示。

Abstract: Advanced digital communication has revolutionized how people create and consume information, making information diffusion an important topic of research for domains from public health to national security. Real-world scenarios of information diffusion often involve competing narratives - true and false - spreading simultaneously. We propose a novel agent-based co-diffusion model, grounded in "complex-contagion" and "spiral of silence" theories, to capture how network dynamics exploit cognitive biases to shape such interactions. Our findings reveal that manipulative narratives dominate when early spreaders hold them. These network dynamics further exploit inherent cognitive biases to amplify information diffusion regardless of veracity. Further, while favourable previous experience strengthen collective optimism, unfavourable experiences attenuate optimism only modestly. However, we found that early seeding of agents with lower self-censorship not only constrains the spread of manipulation but can also lead to dominance of well-informed populance. This has implications for policies that aim to facilitate healthier discourse, strengthen social cohesion, and ensure equitable access to reliable information.

</details>


### [311] [Modest Algorithmic Mediation can Maximize Topical Diversity in Hybrid Human-AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24698)
*Dini Wang,Ho-Chun Herbert Chang*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文研究社交网络与算法推荐如何共同影响信息多样性。基于18,076名用户2014-2018年的数据，发现算法排名引入后分享多样性先升后平，但不平等性加剧。提出混合人机信息扩散模型，发现适度算法介入可提升多样性并降低不平等，而过度介入则适得其反。模型拟合显示算法介入份额从0增至约0.5，处于多样性提升区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究算法推荐时代下，社交网络与算法架构如何共同塑造信息分享多样性的变化，特别是解耦两种传播机制的各自贡献及交互效应。

Method: 基于18,076名用户2014-2018年的实际数据，提出混合人机信息扩散模型，将信息曝光建模为用户关注网络的社会传播与算法推荐的参数化混合，结合定性分析与仿真实验。

Result: 算法排名引入后分享多样性先升后平，不平等性同时出现；算法中介效应呈非单调性：适度介入提升多样性并降低不平等，强介入则降低多样性并集中于少数用户；模型拟合显示算法份额从0增至约0.5，超过平等补偿点但仍在多样性提升区间。

Conclusion: 识别出算法推荐拓宽而非窄化信息曝光的条件，为混合人机系统中的信息扩散提供了统一分析框架。

Abstract: In the artificial intelligence (AI) era, the rise of algorithmic feeds has fundamentally transformed information diffusion on social media. While early platforms organized visibility through explicit social networks, contemporary systems mediate exposure through intelligent recommender algorithms that personalize attention. This paper examines how the social network and algorithmic architecture jointly shape the diversity of information sharing. Analysis of 18,076 users active throughout 2014--2018 shows that the topical diversity of sharing rose and then plateaued after the introduction of algorithmic ranking in 2016 while its inequality across users emerged alongside it. To this end, we introduce a hybrid human-AI information diffusion model in which information exposure is governed by a parameterized mixture of social propagation through the user-following network and algorithmic recommendation. Both qualitative analysis and simulations show that the effect of algorithmic mediation is non-monotonic. Modest mediation can raise average diversity and reduce inequality relative to a purely network-driven baseline, whereas strong mediation reduces diversity and concentrates it among fewer users. Fitting the model to four years of data yields a mediation share that increases from zero before 2016 to approximately 0.50 by 2018, a level that exceeds the compensation point of equality while remaining within the diversity-enhancing range. These results identify the conditions under which recommendation broadens rather than narrows exposure and provide a unified framework for information diffusion in hybrid human-AI systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [312] [Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22544)
*Yassine Oueslati,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: C-VCE是一种将分类器直接内置到扩散模型中的概念瓶颈框架，通过可解释的概念特征而非外部噪声鲁棒分类器来引导反事实生成，在保持图像质量的同时实现更小、更可控的编辑，并在CelebA等基准上达到或优于现有方法的翻转率与视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的反事实解释方法依赖外部分类器，而这些分类器需要在噪声图像上可靠工作，导致系统脆弱且难以部署。作者希望构建一个无需额外噪声鲁棒分类器的鲁棒反事实生成框架。

Method: 1) 在扩散模型中内建概念瓶颈层，用可解释的人类语义概念替代外部分类器；2) 支持用户在采样时开关语义概念，最小化调整相关区域并保留无关区域；3) 引入概率正则化项平衡"改变预测"与"贴近原图"；4) 使用基于梯度的掩码限制修改区域。

Result: 在CelebA等基准上，C-VCE匹配或提高了翻转率，同时生成的反事实图像在视觉上更接近输入、失真更小，优于依赖外部噪声分类器的基线方法。

Conclusion: C-VCE提供了一种实用的"what-if"图像生成工具，无需信任额外的噪声鲁棒分类器。通过暴露和控制内部概念层，有望让生成模型更易理解、更安全使用。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

</details>


### [313] [SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22548)
*Giovanni B. Esposito,Francesco Antici,Daniele Cesarini,Andrea Bartolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SeT-Diff，首个面向计算节点遥测数据的扩散基础模型，通过语义条件生成实现数字孪生，支持零样本置换稳定性和多种下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HPC机器学习方法依赖固定传感器变量的静态子集，任务变更或传感器指标变化时模型失效，缺乏通用性和灵活性。

Method: 基于扩散模型，将生成过程条件化于每个传感器的语义描述，解耦系统动力学与数据集结构。

Result: 在真实超算数据集上重建任务MAE为0.0470；零样本下传感器打乱仍保持精度；单一模型可完成数据插补、预测和虚拟传感，热推理MAE达0.033。

Conclusion: SeT-Diff是HPC系统高效的数据驱动数字孪生，具备泛化性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

</details>


### [314] [QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22549)
*Winson Chen,Yuqi Zhang,Sixu Chen,Nuo Xu,Qiang Guan,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了QFoldAgent，一个用于5残基四面体格点蛋白质折叠的闭环多智能体框架。通过设计智能体、VQE量子-经典流水线和反馈智能体的迭代协作，系统性地优化哈密顿量惩罚权重。在QDockBank基准上中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，在未见序列上结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于格点的混合量子-经典蛋白质结构预测工作流通常手工固定哈密顿量惩罚系数，且仅在模拟中评估极短片段，缺乏系统性优化惩罚权重的方法，导致预测效果受限。

Method: 提出QFoldAgent闭环多智能体框架：1) 设计智能体根据序列提出条件化惩罚权重；2) VQE量子-经典流水线在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量；3) 反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号迭代改进惩罚权重。仅使用RMSD等真实指标进行评估，不用于智能体训练。

Result: 在QDockBank基准上中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，最难靶标提升最大；在100个未见序列上结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%初始无效案例被恢复；最强控制器在87%序列上改善第三周期能量，同时维持96%的Ramachandran偏好几何。

Conclusion: 迭代智能体控制能系统地改善量子环境中的优化行为并减少失败案例，证明了闭环方法在5残基量子蛋白质折叠中的有效性。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation.
